description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating fingerprint authentication, key management, and secure cryptography. It initializes cryptographic keys, handles user authentication via fingerprint, encrypts a secret message, and manages UI interactions for purchase actions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing fingerprint authentication, cryptographic key creation, and user purchase interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes cryptographic components, checks device security, sets up UI buttons, and creates cryptographic keys.

methods.name: initCipher
methods.description: Initializes a Cipher object with the specified key from the KeyStore for encryption.

methods.name: onPurchased
methods.description: Handles post-authentication purchase logic, optionally encrypting data if fingerprint authentication was used.

methods.name: showConfirmation
methods.description: Displays a confirmation message; shows encrypted data if available.

methods.name: tryEncrypt
methods.description: Attempts to encrypt a secret message using the provided Cipher.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key with specified parameters in the Android KeyStore.
